subject.title: feat: let a clerk mark stock status and hide out-of-stock products

question: Should the combined Save wait for an atomic conditional/transactional persistence primitive rather than merge with a rollback that can overwrite another clerk's price?
rationale: The current storage interface cannot make the rollback comparison and restore atomic, so preserving the advertised all-or-nothing Save semantics needs an intentional persistence strategy.

options.title: Add atomic conflict protection
options.body: Provide a conditional or transactional save/rollback path and prove that a competing later price remains unchanged.

options.title: Defer the combined Save
options.body: Keep price and stock writes separate until the storage layer can preserve both records without a lost-update window.

options.title: Accept independent writes
options.body: Document that price and stock status may commit independently instead of promising compensating rollback semantics.

recommendation.title: Add atomic conflict protection
recommendation.body: Provide a conditional or transactional save/rollback path and prove that a competing later price remains unchanged.
